title: fix(skills): root-anchored ignore rules like /build hide nested skills
body:
Closes #162437

## What Problem This Solves

A root-anchored ignore rule such as `/build` was broadened to `build` by the shared ignore-rule prefixer. Standalone SDK sessions using `DefaultResourceLoader` consequently lost nested skills such as `deploy/build/SKILL.md`. Root-anchored negations were also broadened.

## User Impact

Root-anchored rules and negations remain rooted in SDK skill and package-resource scans using the shared matcher. Unanchored rules retain their existing recursive behavior. Thanks to @boeingchoco for reporting the bug and contributing this fix and regression test.

Scope clarification: the CLI `skills list` and embedded Gateway use a different, native workspace discovery path. That path does not apply these `.gitignore` rules; this PR does not change it. The real CLI listed both top-level and nested fixtures before and after this patch. The Gateway's resource loader explicitly disables ambient SDK skill discovery. The before/after evidence below therefore uses the actual affected consumer: standalone SDK sessions with `DefaultResourceLoader`.

## Why This Change Was Made

At the scan root the directory prefix is empty, so stripping the leading slash changed `/build` into `build`. Preserve the original pattern at the root and leave nested-directory prefixing unchanged. No new configuration or stored-data changes.

No overlap with Pash/Sarah changes.

## Evidence

Observed in secretless Node 26 Docker isolation, current main `084990ed4f70d726fccc009c727e5741fa84d67d` versus this exact head `aa0ce28376e313edb2f06756dc7fd4460a2b8499`:

- Created real `build/SKILL.md`, `deploy/build/SKILL.md`, `keep/SKILL.md`, and `deploy/keep/SKILL.md` fixtures.
- Ran six real `createAgentSession` turns with `DefaultResourceLoader`, real filesystem skill discovery, and a local mock OpenAI-compatible HTTP provider. Captured the outgoing provider requests; every turn returned `Proof complete.` with stop reason `stop`.
- With `/build`: main's provider prompt contained neither build skill. The candidate prompt contained `deploy-build` and excluded `root-build`.
- With unanchored `build`: both revisions excluded both build skills.
- With `keep` followed by `!/keep`: main incorrectly included both keep skills. The candidate included only `root-keep` and excluded `deploy-keep`.
- State/config/SQLite paths were resolved and checked under isolated task roots before execution, with explicit base/candidate profiles and separate local ports. No live state or real provider/channel credentials were used.
- The contributed regression file against main: 1 failed, 11 passed, failing on nested `skills/build/`. Candidate: 12 passed, 2.21 seconds wrapper wall time (new case 1 ms).
- Existing exact-head ClawSweeper review is ready, with no actionable findings.

The contributor also reported passing package-manager sibling coverage and changed-file checks; those broader checks were not rerun during this adoption.

## CI

Exact-head run [36823043455](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36823043455) has a failed aggregate gate with 0 cancelled jobs. Failures are inherited and outside this two-file matcher/test diff:

- `check-prod-types` and `check-test-types-core-1` through `core-5`: TS2304 `readMissingScopeError` at `ui/src/components/session-group-defaults-dialog.ts:123`.
- `checks-ui-e2e (4/9)`: `session-management.group-defaults.e2e.test.ts`, outside-workspace admin requirement remains `checking` instead of `restricted`. These UI cases also occurred in [#162435's run and documented override](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/162435#issuecomment-5926827254). This PR's merge base `1fbf9a4623b23862843f720b5e07338b85387fb2` predates main's fix `03137c1d729e25edbdb4dc482730aed74a6c2427` importing the missing reader. This diff does not touch the UI.
- `checks-fast-baseline-ratchets`: `spawnSync rg ENOENT`, matching [the missing-ripgrep runner failure](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36820059828/job/110233863793).
- `checks-node-changed-compact-large-35-3`: swarm collector completion-order assertion, matching [this independent run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36823552980/job/110244508637).
- `checks-node-changed-compact-large-7`: Windows update interrupted-file restoration ENOENT, matching [this independent run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36823552980/job/110244511458).

The change cannot affect runner binary availability, UI missing imports, update restoration, or swarm completion scheduling. Selected node lanes covering the matcher passed; no cancelled-lane replay is needed. No CI reruns or branch refreshes were requested.
